source_refs.note: 'Data Storage and Management Concepts' under topic 6.2, as printed (PDF 78, printed 74).

blocks.text: Data storage refers to saving data for future use. Data can be stored in files, databases, or cloud systems. Proper storage helps protect data from loss. Data management involves organizing and maintaining data. It ensures data is easy to find and use. Security is an important part of data management. Backup systems help prevent data loss. Well-managed data improves efficiency. Data management supports long-term data use.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Proper understanding of data type is very important before analysis of data.
